F printed parts

Chassis prints floor down, hub bore up, cage open end up, hood face down. Not one of them needs support. Slicer hole compensation must be off, the allowance is already in the model.

H print check

The build tag is a hash of the geometry embedded here. verify.py recomputes it from the STLs and tells you if this page has gone stale. Every layer was walked against the one below. Nothing overhangs past 45 degrees with no support under it, so no part needs support material.

G measured component data

Stepper figures from the NopSCADlib measured vitamin set, mirror from Cloudray and OMTech spec sheets, module from the listing. Every fit in the STLs derives from these.
